messages:
incident-bot: ALERT triggered · p99 latency > 3s for chat/completions routes (group: chat-ingest)

maria (oncall): getting page. seeing p99 spike ~3.4s across a subset of routes. no errors, just slow.

sam (sre): confirmed. spike matches high-concurrency windows from 08:12-08:20. per-model breakdown: mistral-large and vicuna-13b variants show biggest variance.

eli (eng-platform): is this the routing change we deployed last night? small rollout to route-weight adjustments for dedicated pools.

maria (oncall): rollout logs show 03:45 UTC weight delta -> extra traffic to pool-3.

deploy-bot: deploy redwood/routing-service@v1.14.2 completed by @eli — metadata: rollout-id=rl-2026-03-11-0345

sam (sre): hypothesis: pool-3 is saturated for longer sequences, batching thresholds causing backpressure and bumping p99. p95 less affected but trending up.

katie (product): any customer-impact yet? any 5xx or degraded responses returned to clients?

maria (oncall): no 5xxs so far. postgres traces show request latencies returning ok. In-app metrics show small retry uptick (0.6% of requests). customer-impact: subtle, some interactive customers may notice chat stuttering.

eli (eng-platform): mitigation plan: 1) revert weight change for pool-3 (roll back) 2) temporarily raise p95 squelch for chat routes to reduce pager noise while we investigate 3) add per-model p95/p99 dashboards and adjust thresholds for high-variance models.

maria (oncall): rolling back now. will also add short squelch on p95 alerts for 10m to avoid paging on noise.

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-11-0345 -> rollback initiated by @maria

sam (sre): rollback done. tailing metrics. p99 dropping from 3.4s -> 1.9s over next 90s. p95 back to ~600ms.

maria (oncall): paging noise reduced. still want durable fixes.

eli (eng-platform): agree. two follow-ups: A) refine alert thresholds per-route and per-model. B) build a small dashboard showing seq_len distribution + kv-cache-hit + batch-size by model.

katie (product): recommend we communicate to customers who hit retries in last 24h. ops -> run a query for requests with retry>0 between 07:50-08:30 UTC.

sam (sre): on alerts: current config is global p95=800ms, p99=3000ms for chat/completions. that's noisy for mistral-large which has p95 natural variance ~1.1s. I propose: set per-model p95 thresholds: mistral-large p95=1200ms, vicuna-13b p95=1000ms; keep p99 global at 3000ms for safety but add model-specific p99 if needed. Also add route tags so alerts can be driven by route-level SLO.

eli (eng-platform): write up for implementation: - metadata keys: model_group, route_name, seq_len_bucket - new alert rule examples: "chat.mistral-large.p95 > 1.2s sustained 5m" and "chat.*.p99 > 3s" - add automatic squelch window for bursty infra events.

maria (oncall): creating incident doc and postmortem link. minimal customer impact. no P0.

katie (product): for comms: short note to affected customers, emphasize rollback & monitoring + next steps.

sam (sre): immediate action items: 1) create per-model p95 alert rules and test in staging (assigned: eli) 2) build dashboard with sequence-length and batching metrics (assigned: sam + eli) 3) run query for retries and prepare customer list (assigned: katie) 4) add runbook entry for rollbacks tied to route-weight changes (assigned: maria).

eli (eng-platform): will put PR with alert YAML and dashboard config. starting now.

maria (oncall): handoff to daytime oncall @eli in 10m. logging final metrics snapshot in incident doc. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT closed (severity: S1 -> S3) — reason: rollback mitigated latency, no errors observed.

maria (oncall): closing thread, will add post-incident notes and link to follow-up ticket RP-452.

sam (sre): quick note — consider instrumenting KV cache eviction rates per model; suspicion that longer sequences amplified cache churn when pool-weight changed.

eli (eng-platform): noted. adding to RP-452. will include example Grafana panels and alert rules in PR.

katie (product): thanks team. will draft customer outreach after we have retry list.

maria (oncall): thanks — good job moving fast.
